//: Machine-local overrides for the deliver/pr-* skill family. Copy to ~/.claude/local/config.json and fill in. Never commit the filled-in copy: it names private repos, hosts and bot accounts.
//protected_branches_extra: Branch patterns that are ALSO protected, on top of the built-in main, master and stage-*. Entries are glob patterns: a bare name matches exactly, * matches any run of characters, so "rc-*" covers every dated release candidate. Used by deliver, pr-open, pr-babysit, pr-merge.
//pr_review_default_repo: owner/repo that pr-review targets when the cwd has no useful origin remote. Omit to always derive from git remote get-url origin.
//rebase_sync_repos: owner/repo entries whose CLAUDE.md mandates rebase-before-push. For these, pr-babysit/pr-merge rebase onto the target and force-push with --force-with-lease instead of merging forward.
//ai_reviewer_usernames_gitlab: GitLab usernames of AI reviewers, added to the built-in list. Comments from these are auto-addressed; everything else batches as human.
//ai_reviewer_usernames_github: GitHub usernames of AI reviewers, added to the built-in ["cursor"]. The [bot] suffix is stripped before matching.
//sonar_host_url: SonarQube base URL. Omit or leave empty to skip the SonarQube phase entirely.
//bot_noise_body_markers_extra: Extra HTML-comment markers that identify a bot comment as noise, added to the built-in list.
//verification_addenda: Extra verification commands for repos whose nested apps own a separate pipeline. Run by self-review and pr-merge when a changed path starts with when_paths_under.

verification_addenda.run: cd apps/example && pnpm install && pnpm lint && pnpm test && pnpm build
